content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD v3.3 multi-GPU CUDA Fortran port의 eight GPU source files를 전수 읽은 algorithm/subroutine map이다(1-12행). mod_cuda device state, initialization, HUV RK and two tridiagonal paths, MGPU variants, exchange/periodic halo, breaker/mask/mixing/sponge kernels를 열거한다(14-54행). CPU/GPU implementation differences and CUDA mechanisms are tabulated at 56-70행.
entities: mod_cuda device state, streams, cuSPARSE workspace, tiles and arrays (lines 14-17)
TriSolver 0 Thomas and TriSolver 1 cuSPARSE paths (lines 36-39)
breaking, masks, mixing and sponge GPU kernels (lines 50-54)

constants.name: BlockDim
constants.value: 2D 16 and Inner 14 tiles with halo difference 2

params_defined.name: title
params_defined.default: FUNWAVE-GPU full analysis — CUDA Fortran kernels, cuSPARSE, MGPU

params_defined.name: verification_method
params_defined.default: full read of eight GPU source files

calls: INITIALIZATION_GPU conditionally calls cusparse_init for TriSolver==1 (line 24)
ESTIMATE_HUV_GPU launches HUV_BAR_KERNEL, selected tridiagonal path, post_tridiagonal_kernel (line 27)
TriSolver 0 calls transpose and streamed per-row Thomas kernels (line 37)
unresolved: tridiagonal coefficient is summarized as Gamma1*MASK9_d*dep^2*DX^2 (line 31). A second-derivative implicit operator normally scales with inverse DX^2; the note's multiplication is dimensionally opposite and may be a transcription error.

TriSolver is declared as a 0/1 switch (line 16) and tested during INITIALIZATION_GPU (line 24), but no initialization/default or input assignment is described before that test. A use-before-assign or undocumented default is possible in the presented flow.
WaveMaker strings are converted to an integer WaveMakerCode because kernels cannot compare characters (line 24), but the mapping table, invalid-string behavior, and CPU/GPU enum parity are absent.

the GPU breaker intentionally reads AGE_BREAKING0_d rather than in-place AGE to remove a CPU order dependency (line 51). This changes update semantics; no CPU/GPU numerical equivalence or convergence comparison is provided.
sponge damping divides Eta_d by SPONGE_d in place (line 54). The only stated guard is MASK_d>0; no SPONGE_d nonzero/range guard is shown.

MGPU halo and tridiagonal paths are described with cudaMemcpy2D/cudaMemcpy2dAsync and MPI (lines 39, 46, 48), but this file reports no MGPU run, rank-count range, pinned-host requirement, or numerical halo comparison.
transpose_kernel is labeled coalesced (lines 33, 64) without stating whether both read and write are coalesced; the implementation summary does not establish the claimed access property.
